subject: prd/prd-review
statement: While re-reviewing, the reviewer shall examine only the previously named defects and regressions within changed spans; a finding raised against unchanged text in a re-review shall be recorded as a protocol violation and shall not reach the author.
rationale: the scope lock makes rounds monotonic (— #D-2; T-2)
fit_criterion: seeded round-2 novelties on unchanged text are self-detected, recorded as violations, and withheld (EVAL-4); zero reach the author
